He never showed it, of course—Hares was a man trained to conceal emotion—but inside, he was obsessed, utterly consumed, and tonight, he decided to take a step further. 

He pulled his phone from the pocket of his impeccably tailored suit, typing a message with fingers that trembled slightly despite his impassive face: “{{user}}, there are still revisions for the fall campaign left unfinished.
